name: kuypoker
description: Cardora — platform game kartu multiplayer (web, iOS, Android).

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c green,yellow "npm run dev -w @kuypoker/server" "npm run dev -w @kuypoker/web"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/engine --noEmit && tsc -p packages/server --noEmit && tsc -p packages/web --noEmit
scripts.build: npm run build -w @kuypoker/web && npm run build -w @kuypoker/server
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build -w @kuypoker/web && npx --prefix packages/web cap sync
scripts.cap:android: npm run build -w @kuypoker/web && npx --prefix packages/web cap add android && npx --prefix packages/web cap open android
scripts.cap:ios: npm run build -w @kuypoker/web && npx --prefix packages/web cap add ios && npx --prefix packages/web cap open ios
scripts.android:debug: npm run cap:sync && cd packages/web/android && gradlew assembleDebug
